result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue in the bottom navigation.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal bar runs across the bottom navigation and overlaps the search and saved/bookmark icons, making the controls look corrupted or partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the bar so it does not intersect the navigation icons. If it is intended as a gesture indicator or active-tab marker, place it below the icons with proper spacing and a shorter centered width.
